sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Sec.482 Cr.P.C., by the Petitioner/Accused No.2, seeking to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.305 of 2014 on the file of the Court of the Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Chirala for the offence under Section 3(1)(zz)(v), 26(2)(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Chirala
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner is present.

3. At the time of hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner, on instructions, would submit that the matter becomes infructuous on the ground that the Petitioner/Accused No.2 died and the case against him is abated.
4. In that view of the matter, nothing survives in keeping the criminal petition pending for adjudication.
Therefore, recording the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, this criminal petition is dismissed as infructuous.
Pending applications, if any, shall stand closed.
Dinesh HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE DUPPALA VENKATA RAMANA CRIMINAL PETITION No.11677 OF 2014 18.11.2022
